$comment: SCOPE WARNING: permissions.deny applies to every agent in this project, including the main
conversation — it cannot distinguish a research subagent from the skill that dispatched it.
So this list holds only operations NO caller here should ever perform. It deliberately does
NOT deny `git commit`/`git push` (end-work commits and pushes the tracking clone), `git
checkout` (start-work cuts branches), or `gh issue edit`/`create`/`comment`/`close` (rung 2 of
gh-wrapper's ladder, and the documented write path for Relationships via --add-blocked-by).
Research runs in the built-in `Explore` subagent type, spawned with briefs written inline in
each skill. Two mechanisms keep it from writing:
1. HARD — Explore holds no Write, Edit, or NotebookEdit, so the timeline, tracks.yml, and
views/ cannot be touched by a research agent at all.
2. The brief's read-only rule, plus the write-class gate each skill runs on every returned
payload, which discards the whole payload if surface_log shows a non-read call.
Explore DOES hold the GitHub MCP tools, so GitHub-write prevention is (2) only. A custom agent
definition with a `tools:` allowlist would make it structural, but agent definitions cannot
live inside a skill and four self-contained files was the higher priority. Do not describe a
research agent as structurally incapable of writing to GitHub. See gh-wrapper -> Research
Subagents for the portable contract; each workflow skill carries its own gate table.
